wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 12-006 wires DEMO lump playback from the title attract loop and the -playdemo command-line path through the runtime ticcmd stream via one src/vanilla facade (wireDemoPlaybackRuntime.ts) that is a pure re-export barrel over the two read-only modules src/demo/demoParse.ts (parseDemo first-byte header dispatch, DEMO_END_MARKER 0x80, DEMO_VANILLA_VERSION_19 109, DEMO_VANILLA_HEADER_SIZE 13, DEMO_VANILLA_COMMAND_SIZE 4, DEMO_LONG_TICS_VERSION 111, DEMO_OLD_FORMAT_MAX_SKILL 4, DEMO_MAX_PLAYERS 4, DEMO_TIC_RATE 35, DemoFormat/DemoTicCommand/ParsedDemo) and src/demo/demoPlayback.ts (DemoPlayback streaming reader, DEMO_PLAYBACK_DEFAULT_VERSION 109, DemoPlaybackCompletionAction/Options/Snapshot). The value/type split keeps verbatimModuleSyntax happy and no const enums are re-exported. VANILLA_DEMO_PLAYBACK_INVARIANTS pins five rules: first-byte header dispatch matches G_DoPlayDemo; shareware DOOM1.WAD attract demos are version 109 / 13-byte header / 4-byte ticcmds / 0x80 terminator; readNextTic yields one tic of active-player ticcmds per call in playeringame[] order; the final real tic is returned before the marker-crossing null (G_ReadDemoTiccmd timing, no off-by-one); G_CheckDemoStatus completion is quit for -playdemo/singledemo else advance-demo for the title loop with net/deathmatch/monster flags reset to 0. The focused test exercises a real synthetic vanilla demo: parseDemo header/ticcmd decode, two-tic streaming playback with the attract-loop advance-demo completion, the singledemo quit completion, the version-mismatch RangeError gate, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral (statically imports only the non-inventoried facade; demo modules reached via await import()).
